Method of Attack: Steals private keys and seeds of Ethereum wallets by capturing user input and sending stolen data to attackers via Telegram
Monitors device clipboard for Bitcoin and Ethereum addresses and swaps them with attacker-controlled addresses
Discoverer: ESET Android security researcher Lukas Stefanko
Attack Vector: Malicious Android app uploaded to Google Play store
Indicators of Compromise: Telegram account receiving stolen keys and seeds
APK file containing code to send stolen data to Telegram
